title: Unaccompanied Blue
style: folk, soulful, jazz, a cappella, female vocals, warm, soft, metal, vocal, soulful, classic, vocal jazz, swing, noise, soul, a cappella, rhythmic, jazz, world, harmony, sophisticated, rich, strong, raw, low, emotional
lyrics:
[Intro: Scat
Solo Lead
Intimate]
Mmm
Ba da ba doo
Dee ba doo ba dee da
La da da da
Ba doo ba dee ba da da

[Verse 1]
The spotlight's just a memory
The stage is bare and true
No ivories to tickle
No rhythm section crew
It's me and the microphone and the air that I move
Turning silence into music with nothing left to prove
The blue notes bend and waver from the center of my chest
They tell the story better when there's nothing to impress
No safety in the changes
No cover in the chord
Just the truth in the timbre and the meaning in the word

[Pre-Chorus]
And when the world gets heavy with its noise and its demands
I strip it all away with these two open hands

[Chorus]
Unaccompanied blue
That's where I belong
Voice against the darkness
Singing out strong
No band to lean on
No beat to define
The swing comes from within
And the soul is the spine
Jazz in its purest
The way it was meant
When the instrument is human and the heart is the tent
Unaccompanied blue
Let the melody fly
On the wings of the voice that refuses to die

[Scat Chorus: Full Group Harmonies
Building]
Ba da ba doo ba dee
Ba da ba doo ba da
Shoo ba dee da da
La da da ba doo
(overlapping voices, rich chords, rhythmic drive through phrasing only)

[Verse 2]
They told me I needed the players to make the music right
But I found the whole orchestra in the depth of the night
In the space between the phrases where the echo used to hide
I discovered the power when the ego steps aside
It's the crack in the high note
The growl in the low
The breath that carries everything the heart needs to show
No wires
No wood
No metal
No skin
Just the flesh and the feeling and the fire within
